citations.claim: before crossing, light-body centre is left of thin wall (wall spans x=12 to 12.1)
first violating step: light-body centre has jumped to right of wall, crossing through it between steps 3 and 4

counterfactual.change: increased wall thickness w from 0.1 to 1.0 only; thicker wall stops the pushed light body so no centre crossing occurs

explanation: Heavy body (m=20, vx=60) catches and pushes light body (m=0.2) into thin wall (w=0.1 at x=12). The body-body impulse accelerates the light body to ~25-59 m/s while in contact (touching pair at step 3), and wall collision handling fails to stop it, so its centre jumps from x~11.67 (left of wall) to x~12.81 (right of wall) between steps 3 and 4, i.e. straight through the 0.1-thick box.

violation.detail: body centre moved through wall 0 between steps 3 and 4

vision_note: The large blue body catches up to the small red body and shoves it against the vertical wall. In step 4 the red body is suddenly on the opposite side of the wall while the blue body stays behind, showing it tunneled straight through.
